
When worrying about whether or not a word is legal, please recall that all brivla must be stressed on the second to last syllable.

"'''[[nice fu'ivla forms|nice fu'ivla forms]]'''" are those forms that don't contain VVV, CC/C or CCCC groups, which can never appear in lujvo, and start with one or two consonants. These nice forms are the ones that sit most comfortably among native Lojban forms.

4-letter fu'ivla

*VCCV  iglu alga (in all cases where CC is allowed non-initially, C/C is also allowed. Those are not listed separately.

5-letter fu'ivla

*CCVVV praia
*CCCVV spra'i (VV can't be a diphthong)

*VCCVV ostoi
*VCCCV astro

*VVCCV uiski

Notably, CCVCV and CVCCV aren't present in the above list, as those are the forms used by gismu.

6-letter fu'ivla

*'''CVVC/CV''' ma'agni
*CVCC/CV saprka

*CCVVVV brai'oi  
*'''CCVVCV''' tce'exo

*CCCVVV stroia
*CCCCVV tsmla'i (VV can't be a diphthong) (camxes won't like this form because of the initial cluster)

*VC/CVVV iksoia
*VC/CVCV odbenu

*VCCCVV astroi (VV must be a diphthong)
*VC/CCVV aksroi

*VCC/CVV asrkoi
*VCCCCV astrgo

*VVCCVV iandau
*VVCCCV iastro

*VVVCCV uaisto

*CVVVCCV sa'aispa
*'''CVVCCVV''' saispai (the second C can't be 'r' or 'nr')

*'''CVVCCCV''' saispra (the second C can't be 'r' or 'nr')
*CVC/CVVV sarpaia

*'''CVC/CVCV''' sarpasa

*'''CVC/CCVV''' sarprai
*CVCC/CVV sabrpai

*CVCCCCV satspra

*CCVVVCV spaiapa

*CCVCVVV spapaia
*'''CCVCVCV''' spapapa

*CCVCC/CV spaprka

*CCCVVCV spraika
*CCCVC/CV jglandi

*CCCCVVV tsmlaia (dubious initial cluster)
*CCCCVCV tsmlatu (dubious initial cluster)
